scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Saturday’s outdoor music stop workable for the twin toddlers if they attend after the family table.
Emerging Need: The plan is tentative until attendance is confirmed, then a heat-exposed courtyard and limited shaded stroller holds create a preventable comfort and safety risk.
Decision Context: The venue route, heat notice, hold deadline, Isabel’s confirmation, and a stored toddler shade boundary must align before any coordination is justified.
Consequence: An advance shade hold is one preventive route; after its cutoff, discussing a changed arrival plan remains useful. Prevention of the first exposed wait is too late only once that wait has already happened.

parameter.title: Westside Plaza Día del Niño music hour
parameter.description: Possible family stop after the clothing-swap table; outdoor courtyard seating with stroller parking near the west lawn.

parameter.name: Westside Plaza Family Desk
parameter.notes: Handles family seating and stroller-parking notes for Saturday courtyard programs.

parameter.content: If the clothing-swap table wraps on time Saturday, I might bring the twins over to the 3 pm music hour, but I won’t decide until I see how nap goes.

parameter.subject: Saturday courtyard update for Día del Niño
parameter.body: The 3 pm music hour remains in the outdoor courtyard. San Antonio’s posted Saturday heat watch means the west lawn stroller area will be sun exposed by mid-afternoon. The family desk can hold shaded stroller bays for registered family groups until 1:00 pm today; the hold list prints at 1:15 pm. Reply using a table or group label only, not children’s names.

parameter.content: Nap timing is set now. I’m bringing both twins to the 3 pm music hour after the table, and we’ll use the stroller so they can rest while we wait.

We arrived at 15:00 without a shade reservation; all shaded stroller bays were occupied, so the twins spent the first ten minutes waiting in the sun. I have taken them into the indoor lobby now and we are skipping the courtyard queue. That first exposed wait has already happened.
